entityStatement: The Mortgage Advisory, Inc. is a direct mortgage lender (mortgage banker) licensed in California, Texas, Florida, and Colorado, NMLS #1549739. Founded by Ace Ausar, a mortgage banker with 25+ years in real estate and lending. We offer home purchase loans, refinancing, HELOCs and home equity access, reverse mortgages (HECM and proprietary, including second-lien reverse mortgages), debt consolidation using cash-out refinances, HELOCs, or reverse mortgage seconds, and FHA, VA, conventional, and Non-QM loans.
